Gemini 2.5 Pro CD Review -- Crown V3 Cage Match Contender A

Date: 2026-03-23 File: crown-v3-cagematch-A.mov Model: gemini-2.5-pro

Overall: D+ / 4 out of 10

Category Grades

Category Grade Key Issue
HOOK (first 3s) B Good statement, static text limits it
VISUAL QUALITY D Muddy filter kills before/after contrast
TEXT/MOTION GRAPHICS F Static text, looks like free app default
AUDIO MIX D Generic track, zero sound design
PACING & EDITING C- "WE FIXED IT" at cut 2 spoils the arc
STORY ARC C Bones are there, punchline in cut 2 deflates journey
BRANDING & CTA C Present but buried on black end screen
BLACK FRAMES / DEAD SPOTS F Video ends on black screen
SCROLL TEST D Would get swiped after 5-7 seconds

Top 5 Priority Fixes (non-negotiable per reviewer)

  1. RE-GRADE THE ENTIRE VIDEO -- kill the muddy filter, high-contrast grade, before=gritty, after=pristine
  2. RE-ANIMATE ALL TEXT -- kinetic typography, must be in motion, feels intentional
  3. RE-EDIT FOR PACE & RHYTHM -- 1-1.5s max per shot, sync to beat, remove slow walking shots
  4. ADD SOUND DESIGN -- layer in sounds of work: clicks, whirs, bolts, scraping, caulking
  5. FIX THE ENDING -- remove black screen, final frame = hero shot of new unit + CTA overlaid on video
